messages:
Anna Chen: Quick sync — need a short thread on the conversion narrative heatmap for last week's launch posts. Wanted to align on which dashboard slices we present in the exec readout. 
Miguel Torres: I can pull the heatmap by campaign / landing variant. thinking we show: post -> landing -> webinar signup -> qualified lead. keep it to top 3 funnels. :+1:
Sara Patel: +1. Also include a tiny table for attribution window sensitivity (1d/7d/30d) — execs always ask that.
Jamal Green: Are we still debating last-touch vs weighted multi-touch for this readout? I thought marketing leaned weighted.
Anna Chen: Weighted preferred, but show last-touch as a footnote. main narrative = modelled conversions with decayed weights. keep math simple.
Lucy Huang: I have a heatmap export ready. link: https://rdw.in/heatmaps/launch-2026-03 — note the MAP row is noisy because of organic social spike on Thurs.
Miguel Torres: grabbing raw queries now. if anyone wants the SQL filter: ```SELECT campaign, landing_variant, count(*) as conv, attribution_window FROM events WHERE event IN ('signup','qualified') AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-17' GROUP BY 1,2,4;```
Sara Patel: thanks. can we also add a small column with webinar registrant -> attendee conversion? helps justify the post copy A/B.
Anna Chen: yes — show registrant->attendee and attendee->qualified. That chain helps the narrative about copy iteration.
Jamal Green: FYI, sales noticed higher lead quality from the deep-dive webinar segment (audience tag: enterprise-insights). should we surface that as a callout?
Lucy Huang: I'll annotate the heatmap with that segment as a highlight. :round_pushpin:
Miguel Torres: draft dashboard slides ready. I'll export PNGs and a CSV of the heatmap. planning to drop into the weekly KPI deck.
Anna Chen: Great — target send to the exec deck by EOD. @Growth Bot can you post the summary to #marketing with the slides and a 3-bullet TL;DR when Miguel uploads?
Growth Bot: Automated reminder set — will post a summary once files are uploaded to the shared drive. :robot_face:
Sara Patel: tiny ask — include a one-liner that explains our weighting approach (exponential decay, half-life = 7 days). prevents a 5-min question in the call.
Anna Chen: Good call. Miguel, can you add that short blurb under methodology?
Miguel Torres: yep. I'll add: "Attribution: weighted multi-touch with exponential decay (half-life=7d); last-touch shown for comparison."
Jamal Green: perfect. I'll prep the verbal script for the call to tie it to messaging iteration and lead routing changes.
Anna Chen: Thanks team — if anything blocks EOD ping me.
Miguel Torres: uploading now. ETA 15m.
Lucy Huang: uploaded annotated PNGs to the drive. link: https://rdw.in/drive/launch-heatmap-annotated
Growth Bot: Summary posted to #marketing: "Heatmap + attribution sensitivity for launch posts — weighted multi-touch primary; last-touch in appendix. Slides + CSV in drive."
Anna Chen: Received. I'll review before the 3pm KPI review.
